ownerNativeReport.boundedResult: A-Lab GPSS supplies a real autonomous physical-campaign case in which an erroneous conductivity measurement entered scientific reasoning and allocation. Sample 180 was first recorded as 2.20e-6 S/cm and later corrected to 5.32e-5 S/cm (~24.2x). Published later justifications explicitly reuse the old value to strengthen an ordering/symmetry-lowering mechanism and choose follow-up experiments. Public materials establish stale-value persistence in the published reasoning lineage but do not identify when the correction entered the live agent prompt or whether the live agent ignored it.
ownerNativeReport.currentFrontier: Separate ReplaySensitivity from HistoricalOnlineCorrectionUptake. A contaminated-history versus corrected-history replay is feasible with published prompts/workflow, but historical online uptake requires stronger provenance such as submission timestamps, batch assignments, live prompt/reflection snapshots or correction-propagation logs.
ownerNativeReport.newCounterexample: Submission index is ordered by submission time while the conductivity correction is timestamped only as an update after batch 8; execution batch and submission order are different clocks. Therefore later sample index cannot prove that the correction was available to the Agent when later proposals were formed.
